relationships.evidence_quote: Lipid overlay assays further confirmed direct binding of PDX and NPD1 to GPR37

relationships.evidence_quote: PDX (30 nM) evoked robust Ca²+ increases only in GPR37+ cells (EC50 ≈ 23.5 nM)

relationships.subject: Protectin DX
relationships.evidence_quote: PDX reduced mechanical, thermal, and cold hypersensitivity in WT mice but had no effects in Gpr37−/− mice

relationships.subject: GPR37
relationships.evidence_quote: PDX promotes efferocytosis and macrophage survival through GPR37-dependent Ca²+ and Gi/βγ/PI3K-AKT signaling in vitro and in vivo

relationships.subject: Protectin DX
relationships.evidence_quote: PDX decreased the proportion of AITC-responsive cells from 44.3% to 16.97% and capsaicin-responsive cells from 20.40% to 5.95%

relationships.subject: Protectin DX
relationships.evidence_quote: RNA-seq in fracture DRG showed reduced Trpa1 expression after PDX treatment

key_findings: Protectin DX is a GPR37 ligand that resolves tibial fracture postoperative pain, outperforming other SPMs, steroids, NSAIDs and gabapentin, and promotes macrophage phagocytosis/efferocytosis via GPR37-Ca2+-PI3K/AKT.
PDX suppresses C-fiber reflexes, DRG neuron hyperactivity and TRPA1/TRPV1-evoked pain and neurogenic inflammation.
